# ManagerBench: receipt coverage is not valid prediction coverage

## TL;DR
All 68 historical BehaviorBench arms have receipts, but only 48 have explicit valid-prediction counts. We added a denominator audit to the existing harness without zero-filling unknowns. All 159 tests pass in normal and optimized Python. Unified release candidate remains draft PR #9527.

![Receipt coverage and release gate](/assets/research/managerbench-release-readiness-2026-11-26.svg)

Figure: metadata audit of 68 frozen evaluation arms.

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Receipt arms | 68/68 |
| Explicit valid-count arms | 48/68 |
| Unknown valid-count arms | 20 |
| Receipted predictions | 34918 |
| Known valid count sum | 33018 |
| All valid count | unknown |

## Reproduction
Fetch the pinned PR head into an isolated checkout and replay the existing CLI: 260 rows, 10 historical incomplete arms. The original SHA-256 matches; the new view hash also matches across both execution modes.

```bash
python3 files/eval/managerbench/run.py --root . --check files/eval/managerbench/baseline-2026-11-15.json --capability-scorecard /tmp/managerbench-card.json
python3 -m unittest discover -s files/eval/managerbench -t files/eval/managerbench
python3 -O -m unittest discover -s files/eval/managerbench -t files/eval/managerbench
```

Bad hashes fail before outputs; output path aliases are rejected. The 20 unknown arms do not establish prediction failures. No new inference, training, formal release or production deployment.
